title: Remove permission set ref and move the Page Inspector changes to BCApps
summary: Removes references to the soon-to-be-obsoleted table "Extension Execution Info" from three permission sets: D365 Basic - Read, Page Inspection and VSC Intgr. - Admin. It also moves the Page Inspector changes from Platform into BCApps, updating the Page Inspection pages and the VS Code helper codeunit.
key_points: Removes "Extension Execution Info" from the D365 Basic - Read, Page Inspection and VSC Intgr. - Admin permission sets
The table is about to be obsoleted
Page Inspector changes are moved from Platform into BCApps
Page Inspection Extensions page and Page Inspection VS Code Helper codeunit are reworked
